title: Property Conveyancing & Deed Transfers
subtitle: Legal transfer of residential and commercial property ownership
author: Bouul Legal Team
problemHeadline: Property transfer delays cause unexpected holding costs and risk contract cancellation
problemBody: Errors in deed documents or municipal clearance delays can stall property transfers for months.
bouulSolution: Admitted Conveyancers handle deed searches, clearance certificates, and Deeds Office lodging
Transparent line-item fee structure per Law Society tariff guidelines
Escrow holds professional fees until property transfer is registered at the Deeds Office
aiPromptExample: Book conveyancer: 'Transfer of 3-bedroom house sale in Sandton after offer to purchase signed.'
aiDiagnosisOutput: Scope: Draft transfer docs, obtain SARS Transfer Duty & Rates Clearance, lodge at Deeds Office. Escrow: Tariff.
escrowGuarantee: Escrow released upon registration confirmation at Deeds Office.

articleSections.heading: SARS & Rates Clearance Expediting
articleSections.body: Conveyancers track municipal rates clearance and SARS transfer duty receipts daily to prevent delays.

articleSections.heading: Deeds Office Lodgement Tracking
articleSections.body: Real-time updates as your property documents pass through the 3 levels of Deeds Office examination.

title: Business Contract Drafting & Legal Review
subtitle: Drafting clear, enforceable commercial agreements, NDAs, and SLAs
author: Bouul Legal Team
problemHeadline: Poorly drafted agreements with ambiguous clauses lead to expensive high-court litigation
problemBody: Using generic internet contract templates leaves your South African business legally unprotected.
bouulSolution: Admitted attorneys draft customized agreements tailored to SA contract law and POPIA
Review and redline incoming vendor contracts, lease agreements, and partnership deeds
Escrow released upon delivery of final executable contract document
aiPromptExample: Request contract drafting: 'Draft Service Level Agreement for IT outsourcing company.'
aiDiagnosisOutput: Deliverable: Customized SLA with liability caps, payment terms, and POPIA clauses. Escrow: R3,500.
escrowGuarantee: Escrow released after client approves final contract draft.
pirbStandard: LPC Registered Attorney & Commercial Law Specialist.

articleSections.heading: POPIA Compliance Clause Integration
articleSections.body: Contracts include mandatory Protection of Personal Information Act data processing clauses.

articleSections.heading: Limitation of Liability Protection
articleSections.body: Enforceable clauses cap your business exposure to direct fees paid, excluding consequential losses.

title: Divorce, Custody & Maintenance Legal Representation
subtitle: Compassionate legal guidance for uncontested or contested divorce and child care
author: Bouul Legal Team
problemHeadline: Family legal disputes cause intense emotional stress and financial vulnerability
problemBody: Unclear parental maintenance agreements lead to endless post-divorce disputes over school fees.
bouulSolution: Experienced family law attorneys handle divorce mediation, settlement agreements, and parenting plans
Drafting legally binding Parenting Plans compliant with the Children's Act
Escrow holds fees per phase of legal representation
partsNeeded: High Court / Regional Court filing forms
aiPromptExample: Request family attorney: 'Draft settlement agreement and parenting plan for uncontested divorce.'
aiDiagnosisOutput: Scope: Joint estate division agreement + Children's Act parenting plan + Decree of Divorce. Escrow: R8,500.
escrowGuarantee: Escrow released upon court order endorsement.
pirbStandard: LPC Registered Attorney & Family Law Practitioner.

articleSections.heading: Children's Act Compliance
articleSections.body: Parenting plans prioritize the best interests of the child, defining clear contact schedules.

articleSections.heading: Mediation-First Approach
articleSections.body: Attorneys strive for mediated settlements to avoid ruinous court litigation costs.

title: CCMA Representation & Employment Disputes
subtitle: Legal defense for unfair dismissal claims, retrenchment, and disciplinary hearings
author: Bouul Legal Team
problemHeadline: Navigating CCMA labor disputes without legal counsel risks heavy financial compensation awards
problemBody: Failing to follow strict LRA procedural fairness during disciplinary hearings invalidates dismissals.
bouulSolution: Labor law attorneys represent employers or employees at CCMA conciliation and arbitration
Drafting compliant employment contracts, retrenchment notices, and workplace policies
Escrow released after completion of CCMA hearing or settlement sign-off
aiPromptExample: Book labor attorney: 'Represent employer at CCMA arbitration for alleged unfair dismissal claim.'
aiDiagnosisOutput: Scope: Case prep + CCMA arbitration representation + Bundle of documents. Escrow: R5,500.
escrowGuarantee: Escrow released after arbitration hearing completion.
pirbStandard: LPC Registered Labor Attorney & SASLAW Member.

articleSections.heading: LRA Procedural & Substantive Fairness
articleSections.body: Attorneys ensure all disciplinary steps strictly satisfy Labour Relations Act guidelines.

articleSections.heading: CCMA Settlement Negotiation
articleSections.body: Skilled negotiation often settles disputes at conciliation phase, avoiding long arbitration.

title: Will Drafting & Estate Administration
subtitle: Drafting legally valid wills, trust setup, and Deceased Estate administration
author: Bouul Legal Team
problemHeadline: Dying intestate (without a valid will) causes severe family delays and frozen bank accounts
problemBody: Invalidly witnessed wills are declared null and void by the Master of the High Court.
bouulSolution: Admitted attorneys draft customized wills, testamentary trusts, and living wills
Executors handle Master of the High Court estate reporting, liquidation, and distribution accounts
Escrow released after final executed will delivery
partsNeeded: Master of High Court estate forms
aiPromptExample: Book will drafting: 'Draft joint will for married couple with minor children and trust clause.'
aiDiagnosisOutput: Deliverable: Executed Joint Will + Child Trust Provisions + Asset Schedule. Escrow: R1,800.
escrowGuarantee: Escrow released after client receives original signed and witnessed will.
pirbStandard: LPC Registered Attorney & Fiduciary Institute Member.

articleSections.heading: Testamentary Trust for Minors
articleSections.body: Wills include trust clauses to safeguard inheritance for children until age 21.

articleSections.heading: Master of High Court Compliance
articleSections.body: Wills are structured to ensure seamless acceptance by the Master without queries.

title: Commercial Litigation & Debt Recovery
subtitle: High Court and Magistrate's Court litigation and commercial debt collection
author: Bouul Legal Team
problemHeadline: Unpaid commercial invoices destroy cash flow and strain small business operations
problemBody: Debtors ignoring letters of demand require decisive legal summons action to compel payment.
bouulSolution: Litigation attorneys issue Section 129 notices, letters of demand, and court summonses
Magistrate's and High Court representation for breach of contract and commercial debt recovery
Escrow released per litigation phase (Summons, Judgment, Execution)
aiPromptExample: Book debt recovery: 'Recover R145,000 unpaid commercial invoice from corporate client.'
aiDiagnosisOutput: Phase 1: Demand letter + Section 129 + Magistrate Court Summons. Escrow: R4,500.
escrowGuarantee: Escrow released after completion of phase 1 court filing.
pirbStandard: LPC Registered Attorney & Debt Collectors Council Standard.

articleSections.heading: Section 129 Demand Notices
articleSections.body: Formal legal demand letters give debtors 10 business days to settle before court summons.

articleSections.heading: Writ of Execution Enforcement
articleSections.body: Obtaining court warrants allows sheriff attachment of debtor assets to satisfy judgments.
